```{r}
#workload punctuation reversed: 1=too high workload
data <- read.csv2("data_survey.csv", head=TRUE, sep=";") 

data.stack <- cbind(data[1:3],stack(data[4:30]))

colnames(data.stack) <- c("Year","Question","text","Answer","Student")
data.stack <- na.exclude(data.stack)

# boxplot
library(ggplot2)

#stacked plots
library(tigerstats)
tablita2021 <- rowPerc(xtabs(~Question+Answer,data=data.stack[data.stack$Year==2021,]))
tablita2022 <- rowPerc(xtabs(~Question+Answer,data=data.stack[data.stack$Year==2022,]))
tablita2021_df <- as.data.frame(tablita2021[,1:5])
tablita2022_df <- as.data.frame(tablita2022[,1:5])
myColors <- c("darkgreen","green","orange","red","darkred","black")
#bar plot 
plot2021 <- ggplot(data = tablita2021_df, aes(x =Question , y = Freq, fill = Answer))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 0.7) +
   scale_fill_brewer(palette="RdYlGn", labels=c("Totally disagree/Very Low","Disagree/Low","OK!","Agree/High","Totally agree/Very High"), name="Answer") +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("Percentage") +
  xlab("Question") +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold")) +
 theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold",hjust = 0.5)) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels=unique(data.stack$text)) + xlab("") +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("strbio2021.svg",plot2021,width=10, height=4)

plot2022 <- ggplot(data = tablita2022_df, aes(x =Question , y = Freq, fill = Answer))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 0.7) +
   scale_fill_brewer(palette="RdYlGn", labels=c("Totally disagree/Very Low","Disagree/Low","OK!","Agree/High","Totally agree/Very High"),name="Answer") +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("Percentage") +
  xlab("Question") +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold")) +
 theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold",hjust = 0.5)) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels=unique(data.stack$text)) + xlab("") +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("strbio2022.svg",plot2022,width=10, height=4)





```
